item.title: Annual Train Show Coming to Nappanee March 21
item.description: Members of the Elkhart Model Railroad Club will host the 21st annual train show from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Saturday, March 21, at the Claywood Event Center, 13924 N. 1100 W. (County Line Road), Nappanee.

item.title: Milford Public Library – Celebrate Pi Day March 14
item.description: Milford Public Library will celebrate Pi Day at 10 a.m. Saturday, March 14.

item.title: NWCPL Seeks Cemetery Walk Nominations
item.description: The North Webster Community Public Library has announced that plans are underway for the return of its popular Cemetery Walk this fall and the library is inviting the community to help shape this year’s event.

item.title: Roann Covered Bridge Festival Unveils 2026 Parade Theme
item.description: As the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary of independence, the Roann Covered Bridge Festival has announced a parade theme that honors both national heritage and local pride: “Bridging Liberty, 250 Years United - A Star-Spangled Celebration.”

item.title: Kosciusko County Most Wanted
item.description: The Kosciusko County Sheriff’s Office is requesting assistance in finding people wanted on felony or misdemeanor warrants.

item.title: From Costumes to Strikes, Bowlers Rally for Kids in Kosciusko County
item.description: The big winner of the Big Brothers Big Sisters Bowl for Kids’ Sake fundraiser wasn’t one of the bowling teams, but the current Littles in Kosciusko County and future Littles.

item.title: Boost Your Landscape’s Beauty with Bee-Friendly Shrubs
item.description: Plant a variety of bee-friendly shrubs and enjoy year-round beauty and loads of pollinator appeal.

item.title: North Webster Community Public Library – Deal Yourself In: Euchre Night Returns
item.description: North Webster Community Public Library invites the community to an evening of cards, snacks and friendly competition at its upcoming Euchre Night at 6 p.m. Friday, March 20.
